rules.name: No dynamic code evaluation
rules.message: eval()/new Function() is banned in Sunset Rush sources
rules.suggestion: Keep all game code static in index.html; drive tests via window.__game

rules.name: Gameplay randomness must be seeded
rules.suggestion: Use the seeded rng() exposed by the game core

rules.name: No audio assets
rules.message: Audio must be synthesized with Web Audio (spec sr-pre-audio)
rules.suggestion: Add a synthesized SFX function instead of loading a file

rules.name: No network calls from game or tests
rules.message: Sunset Rush is offline-only: no network calls in game, tests, or gate scripts
rules.suggestion: Remove the call; the game and its gates run fully offline
